decisions.decision: Scoped Step-1 evidence gathering as a focused (non-systematic) review: OpenAlex scoping searches + ASPECT source canvas + two seed papers read in full; full claim-verification gate deferred to manuscript stage.
decisions.why: Prototyping study needs strategies fast; systematic-review machinery would be disproportionate before benchmark design exists.

methodology: Focused literature scoping + code canvas to formulate implementable benchmark strategies
next_action: Await ASPECT bulk-viscosity canvas from background agent, then finalize strategies S1-S4 against material-model interfaces
question: How can dynamic (non-hydrostatic) pressure govern phase transformations in compressible mantle-convection models without generating spurious pressure oscillations — and what role can a bulk-viscosity term (viscous-relaxation timescale) play, in a way compatible with ASPECT's projected density approximation (PDA)?
